narrative:
The model determined that you have a 39% chance of being a bad credit risk. Because this probability crossed the bank's threshold, your loan application was denied.

The three factors that weighed most heavily in this decision were your savings situation, your other installment plans, and the status of your checking account. Your lack of any savings or unknown savings balance was the strongest influence and pushed the prediction toward bad credit risk. Among approved applicants, only 33% have unknown or no savings, while nearly half have less than 100 DM; your profile stood out as higher risk in this area. 

Next, the fact that you have an existing installment plan with a bank worked against you, pulling the prediction further toward denial. Finally, having no checking account also contributed to the negative outcome, although this effect was somewhat smaller than the first two factors.

Taken together, these elements made the model see your application as carrying too much uncertainty. 

To improve your chances next time, focus on building verifiable savings, clearing or consolidating any existing installment plans before applying, and opening and regularly using a checking account. These steps would directly address the main reasons your application was turned down. (198 words)
